The red [[Lurker]]s are [[Charmable animal]]s that can be found on the fringes or in the sewage of [[Kaineng City]]. They are closely related to the blue [[Reef Lurker]]s found in the [[Luxon]] [[region]], [[the Jade Sea]].

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20 depending on unlock progress)
*[[Factions]]
**[[Kaineng City]]
***{{NPC location|Pongmei Valley}} (halfway between [[Maatu Keep]] and [[Boreas Seabed (outpost)|Boreas Seabed]])
***{{NPC location|Shenzun Tunnels}}

== Notes ==
*They walk sideways.
*When a Lurker evolves, its default name is changed to "<evolution prefix> Crab".
*Lurkers deal [[slashing damage]].
*[[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Cantha)''

==Trivia==
*Their left pincers are bigger than their right ones, like [[wikipedia:Fiddler_crab|Fiddler Crab]]s. The shape of the shell is similar too.
